Are you looking for an active job in logistics?

As a Logistics Associate at DHL, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure a smooth sorting process. You will process packages so they can be delivered to customers on time.

Your responsibilities include placing packages on the sorting conveyor belt, processing sorted shipments, and supporting the daily logistics operation. You will work Monday to Friday and be available 3 to 5 days per week. Shifts start around 5:00 PM and end around 2:45 AM. Start and end times may vary.

Packages can weigh up to 25 kg. If a package is heavier or difficult to lift, you will always lift it together with a colleague.

- You are available for at least 3 to 4 days per week
- You are at least 18 years old
- You speak Dutch or English
- You live in or around Zwolle, Meppel or Kampen
- You have your own transportation (car, bicycle or scooter) or live within walking distance of the sorting center

Keep logistics processes running smoothly as a Logistics Problem Solver in Tilburg. In this role, you are the person who responds quickly whenever an issue arises at the cross-dock. Whether it is a sorting error, a damaged shipment or missing documentation, you maintain oversight and ensure that the flow of goods keeps moving. In return, you will receive a gross hourly wage of up to €16.70, a shift allowance for night shifts and the opportunity to be taken over by the client. Ready to use your logistics experience in a varied working environment? Apply today!

Your responsibilities include:

    - Resolving sorting errors, missing documentation and damaged shipments
    
- Unloading incoming trucks
    
- Sorting goods for outbound transport
    
- Scanning and registering goods using handheld scanners and computer systems
    
- Checking shipments for quality and completeness
    
- Coordinating with Customer Service, Planning and Team Leaders to resolve bottlenecks quickly

What's in it for you

    - Gross hourly wage of €14.99 to €16.70
    
- 8.75% shift allowance for worked night shifts
    
- Travel allowance according to the client's collective labour agreement
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Temporary employment contract through Manpower with the opportunity to be hired by the client
    
- Full-time position of 40 hours per week
    
- Varied role with a high level of responsibility within the logistics process

    - Experience with Excel
    
- Affinity with ERP or scanning systems
    
- Good command of Dutch and/or English
    
- Stress-resistant attitude, strong problem-solving skills and the ability to switch quickly between tasks
    
- Willingness to work irregular shifts
    
- Experience in logistics, preferably in a cross-dock environment, is an advantage
